key: <b1>Air gap backup has split into two competing designs: physical isolation and logical software locks. While cloud providers sell immutable object storage as a modern air gap, ransomware groups increasingly hijack administrative identity planes to delete cloud repositories. A physical LTO tape sitting on a shelf or unmounted inside an automated library remains the only recovery copy that network credentials cannot reach or destroy.</b1>
example: Air gap backup has split into two competing designs: physical isolation and logical software locks. While cloud providers sell immutable object storage as a modern air gap, ransomware groups increasingly hijack administrative identity planes to delete cloud repositories. A physical LTO tape sitting on a shelf or unmounted inside an automated library remains the only recovery copy that network credentials cannot reach or destroy.

key: For several years, storage teams replaced offline media with cloud-based immutable buckets and separate backup accounts. The theory seemed sound: configure object lock with compliance retention, lock the policy for thirty days, and treat the bucket as an air-gapped copy.

key: Modern threat actors bypass this safeguard without touching the storage protocol. Instead of breaking cryptographic locks, attackers target the identity plane. Through session token theft, compromised identity provider credentials, or elevated role abuse, intruders gain access to the root tenancy. From that vantage point, attackers do not need to modify locked objects. They can delete the entire cloud subscription, alter billing permissions to cause account termination, or destroy the encryption keys stored in key management services. When the management plane fails, logical isolation vanishes with it.

key: A physical air gap relies on an absolute boundary: the absence of an electrical and network path. An LTO cartridge stores data on barium ferrite or metal particle tape inside a plastic housing. When the write process finishes and the drive unloads the cartridge, all electrical contact ends.

key: Inside an automated tape library, robotic arms place the media into passive storage slots. key: A physical air gap disconnects the storage media entirely from electrical and network connections, as with an ejected LTO tape. Logical gaps can be bypassed if administrative credentials are compromised.
